blurb: Guests can enjoy fast, exciting Zodiac-style boat tours with close-to-the-water views for whale watching and harbor adventures. Tours provide opportunities to see marine wildlife such as humpback whales, gray whales, dolphins, sea otters, sea lions, and sharks. The boats have warm, dry enclosed cabin seating for comfort in all weather conditions.
